title: REQ · Loading message is shown only while history is loading and the list stays rendered
summary: History loading message tied to an actual in-flight request
description: Context: game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx line 47 initialises historyStatus to 'loading' and the effect at L50-L76 returns early without changing it when !open or roundId === ''. Desired behavior: with no round id or a closed sheet there is no request, so status must not be 'loading'. Expected result: the loading message is absent in that case and present while listMine is pending. Why: removes a stuck message and keeps the 401-retry test passing.
acceptance_criteria: Given roundId is '' when the sheet is open, then no 'Loading your suggestions…' text is rendered
Given roundId is set and listMine is pending, then 'Loading your suggestions…' is rendered and the list 'Your suggestions' exists
Given the 401-retry scenario with roundId '', then the three ordered POST calls occur and the list shows 'Sent'

in_scope: historyStatus initial value and early-return branch in ContributionSheet

technical_constraints: Keep the single-writer history status in ContributionSheet
